context:
Goal: cloud sessions reach the sessions on your computer without limiting any session for good.
Problem (cannot undo): a cloud session cannot message a session on your computer; the trust card would open that, but it limits a session to trusted devices for good, and once it stopped every message into a session.
Based on (read): draft PR #1051 (docs/plans/local-session-reach.md, section 4) plans a read path with no trust card.
Based on (incident): on Oct 30 a session that took the trust card stopped receiving every message from other sessions, so the card is refused in coordinator, lane and runner sessions.
Departs from: main, with no reply path from cloud to your computer — adds one of the paths below.
On Nov 2 00:56 CST you picked "Other picks" but named none; this asks again with each pick as its own option.
holds: Building the way cloud sessions reach your computer's sessions.
lane: folded into lane session-messaging-plan (session_013NEJL2btGMLKqHs4cDQSZ6), which designs one way for sessions to reach each other that replaces plain messages; routed 13:12 CST

lastAnswer.note: Owner: are these the only four options? With the 10-message limit this gets complicated; find something better that replaces normal messaging. Routed 13:12 CST to the session-messaging lane.

options.gain: No session is limited for good; coordinators, lanes and runners keep taking messages.
options.how: The session on your computer reads the cloud session's transcript at its own wake, and falls back to a shared artifact board. The trust card stays refused.
options.label: Read path, keep the guard
options.lose: Your computer's session hears only at its own wake; board rows are data, never grants.

options.gain: One simple path that works the same both ways.
options.how: Both sides write and read one shared artifact board; no transcript reads.
options.label: Board only
options.lose: Every message waits for the other side's next wake; no transcript detail.

options.gain: Direct two-way messages for the sessions you pick.
options.how: A session takes the trust card only when you say yes for that session.
options.label: Trust card, on your word each time
options.lose: Each trusted session is limited to trusted devices for good, which cannot be undone, and may stop taking messages as on Oct 30.

options.gain: A measured answer on why the card blocked messages, before any real session takes it.
options.how: One new session takes the card; a lane measures whether messages still reach it, then archives it.
options.label: Test the card once, in a throwaway session
options.lose: One throwaway session is limited for good; the reach plan waits for the test.

ref: draft PR #1051, docs/plans/local-session-reach.md, section 4; roadmap step local-session-reach
reply: No, they aren't the only ones. Your ask from this morning (a plan for messages between sessions that would work in any harness) is now a lane, and it's the right place to answer this too. I've sent it this question with your note: design one way to reach sessions that doesn't depend on Claude Code's message limit. It comes back here with new options.
title: Which way should cloud sessions reach the sessions on your computer?
why: It reaches your computer with no act that cannot be undone.
